Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.rmi.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualViewRmi, VirtualView, Serializable, Remote
public final class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualViewRmi
RMI implementation of the VirtualViewRmi remote view. Wraps a local VirtualView and dispatches every server callback onto a single-threaded executor to keep the RMI thread non blocking.

The client object is exported on the fixed CALLBACK_PORT so the port the server uses to deliver callbacks is predictable and can be opened on firewalls / NATs without having to guess a random port.
